environment.description: Same container image deployed on RHEL 9.3 host with SELinux in enforcing mode (targeted policy). The container runtime (podman 4.7) applies the default container_t SELinux type to the process. Additionally, a custom SELinux module (zipservice_restrict.pp) is loaded that constrains the container_t domain with a type_transition rule: any file_type creation by container_t is restricted via allow rules that ONLY permit write access to objects labeled with the custom type zipservice_data_t (applied to /var/app/** via fcontext). The module explicitly does NOT include allow rules for container_t to write to etc_t, cron_spool_t, usr_t, bin_t, or any other system file types. The MLS range is s0:c142,c857 which further isolates the category. No volume mounts to host paths exist. The /var/app/uploads and /var/app/extracted directories carry the zipservice_data_t label via semanage fcontext rules.
